statusDefinitions.complete: Source logic is implemented and parity-verified for the declared scope.
statusDefinitions.partial: A family-specific implementation exists, but one or more source or renderer contracts remain.
statusDefinitions.not-started: Only the generic fallback is active; the source family graph has not been implemented.
statusDefinitions.mapped: The complete UE graph and parameters are inventoried, but this alone does not claim a runtime port.

Remaining: exact bark normal/roughness, RVT/weather/day-cycle inputs, UE PreIntegratedGF/reflection filtering, SSR/AO composition, and pixel sign-off.
Replace generic fallback with M_CelestialBody graph and masked/emissive contracts.
Exact 256-wide curve-atlas rows, material time, full-cloud family binding, and fog/capture participation; Lite clouds now use the exact engine DitherTemporalAA graph.

Remaining: 128px PF_R8 atlas raster/resample precision, non-surface renderer consumers, and locked full-BP pixel parity; SnowPines Lite correctly keeps the family off.
Verify 256-wide curve-atlas rows, authored VolumeTexture mip/compression sampling, and UE AfterDOF pass scheduling against UE post-process buffers; the supplied pack has no Lite fog material graph.

Remaining: evaluated PerInstanceFadeAmount, authored WPO/spatial masks, UE's independent transmission-shadow/optical-depth buffer, colored AO multibounce, Default Lit specular, and pixel sign-off.

Remaining: validate ten painted weights, AutoCliff, world-aligned normals, RVT/full attributes, UE PreIntegratedGF/reflection filtering, SSR/AO composition, and pixel sign-off.

Remaining: complete camera/player/per-instance inputs and WPO, independent transmission-shadow/optical-depth buffer, colored AO multibounce, Default Lit specular, and pixel sign-off.
Split miscellaneous masters by graph instead of using the texture/color fallback.

Production binding remains the supplied Unity S_Mountain graph with its URP adapter and explicit UE-stage 1/PI boundary; do not replace it with UE Default Lit. Remaining: complete graph/layer inputs, shadow/reflection/AO renderer bridges, and pixel sign-off.

Exact UE material-instance routing, tangent-space BlendAngleCorrectedNormals, and the explicit Three distant-normal response bridge are active; production binding remains the supplied Unity S_Rock graph with its URP adapter and UE-stage 1/PI boundary. Remaining: foreground moss/top-layer and shadow parity, every switch combination, evaluated per-instance fade/LOD state, RVT/reflection/AO renderer bridges, and final sign-off.
Exact curve-atlas rows, sky material branches, fog participation, and captured-SkyLight feedback.

UE 5.8 legacy Default Lit zero-size punctual Lambert/GGX, authored Specular-to-F0, captured-SkyLight diffuse, and split-sum F0/F90 boundaries are source-bound. Remaining: verify projection/sparkle outputs, UE PreIntegratedGF/reflection filtering, SSR/AO composition, and UE debug-buffer pixels.

UV2/vertex-red split, filled-leaf mask, snow, masked shadows, and UE 5.8 subsurface direct/front/back SkyLight response are bound. Remaining: authored WPO/per-instance state, independent transmission-shadow/optical-depth buffer, colored AO multibounce, Default Lit specular, and pixel sign-off.
Port underwater post-process graphs and scene texture/depth inputs.
Port full M_StylizedWater function stack, scene textures, depth, reflections, refraction, and shoreline behavior.
Replace fallback with M_Waterfall graph, flow/WPO, depth, opacity, and lighting contracts.
Separate the legacy M_Water graph from the modern shared water approximation and verify its scene inputs.
Port M_WaterWaves displacement/normal graph and authored time contract.

No source-data gap: direction/sign, tint, and intensity are locked; remove sunFlip diagnostics.
Both point lights are Unitless, inverse-square off, exponent 6, intensity 4, and non-shadowing.

Legacy MSM_DEFAULT_LIT ordinary opaque materials now use source-exact zero-size punctual Lambert/GGX, UE Specular/Metallic-to-F0, shadowed-light placement, and captured-SkyLight diffuse; the split-sum environment F0/F90 boundary is ported without falsely equating Three's DFG/PMREM to UE buffers. Legacy MSM_SUBSURFACE retains source wrap/in-scatter/Beer-Lambert and front/opposite-normal SkyLight terms. Remaining: UE PreIntegratedGF and reflection filtering/encoding, SSR, deferred AO/GetSpecularOcclusion/bent-normal composition, finite-area/anisotropic lights, independent subsurface transmission-shadow/optical-depth, colored AOMultiBounce, Default Lit specular inside the subsurface adapter, TwoSidedFoliage, SingleLayerWater, masked/translucent/refraction, packing/composition, and debug-buffer parity.

Stable-sphere fit, centimetre rounding, 2048 physical/2040 interior four-texel border layout, 4-texel stabilization, 50 m extent clamp, 10% overlap, quality-5 raw-gather Manual5x5PCF, UE soft visibility/NoL receiver scale, and the per-cascade constant-bias receiver equivalent are ported. Remaining: UE primitive caster bounds/culling, caster-normal slope bias in shadow-depth writes, distance-field continuation, and WebGPU pixel sign-off.
Reproduce or bake the authored 300-512 m continuation.

Diffuse now imports the exact nine RGB renderer coefficients from public USkyLightComponent::GetIrradianceEnvironmentMap through an editor-only C++ bridge, analytically transforms the UE basis to Three Y-up, and retains UE's nonnegative clamp, tint, and intensity. The browser 128px/1500m/fog-inclusive recapture is diagnostic/specular-only. Remaining: export GetProcessedSkyTexture filtered mip data, replace Three GGX specular PMREM with UE reflection filtering/encoding, then close SSR/reflection/AO composition and pixel sign-off.

Project r.ReflectionMethod=2 selects screen-space reflections. The captured SkyLight specular PMREM is not a substitute. Port UE SSR depth/normal/roughness ray march, hierarchical tracing, hit validation, edge fade, temporal denoise, reflection-environment fallback, and composition.

The active first analytic term now shades surfaces and participates in SkyLight capture. Remaining: export/port the second term, end-distance and observer-height branches, then prove the source defaults leave them inert.

The active Epic desktop contract is mapped: classic deferred SSAO (not GTAO), pixel path, quality 50/shader quality 2, two levels, view-locked 160cm radius (0.1 full-res/0.17 half-res), exact 64px repeating 4x4 random basis, TAA-index addressing, 12/24 source lookup budgets, 30-80m fade, and exact power-2/intensity-.5 response. Runtime now preserves the source screen-radius/noise/response contract around a WebGPU sampler. Remaining: translate UE WedgeWithNormal/HZB and coarse-pass upsample exactly, apply AO only at the deferred indirect/reflection composite, match buffer quantization, and obtain WebGPU pixel sign-off.

All 16 glTF projections now numerically match their exported CineCamera horizontal-FOV/aspect state. Authored focus/sensor/f-stop/squeeze, reconstructed focal length, UE physical CoC, sign, and +/-2.5% screen-radius clamp are source-hash gated; CameraRender1's actual infinity background radius is only 0.652790 px at 1280 px. Remaining: UE DiaphragmDOF gather/scatter classification/dilation, energy-conserving seven-blade/squeeze kernel, half-resolution tile path, temporal stability, foreground hole filling, translucency scheduling, and pixel sign-off.

The film/grade formula and Apple SDR_ExplicitGammaMapping pow(linear,1/2.2) boundary are source-hash and numerical gated; Three's second sRGB OETF is disabled on this path. Remaining: UE 32-cubed combined-LUT input shaper, quantization/trilinear sampling, native half/backbuffer rounding, and pixel sign-off.

UE 5.8 BM_SOG threshold, R11G11B10 intermediates, six-level high-quality downsample chain, packed separable Gaussian kernels, default tints, 1/6 intensity normalization, and the 0.4 cosine-fourth vignette are ported. Remaining: close half-arithmetic/border-sampler precision, keep the >native-resolution fast-blur branch explicit, and verify the source-disabled lens-flare branch stays inert.

UE's exact DitherTemporalAA graph, Good64x64TilingNoiseHighFreq texture, 1/3 clip, exact 8-sample Halton temporal-upsample jitter, source-hash-gated DOF/AfterDOF -> Gen4 TAA -> bloom scheduling, and the active MainUpsampling/High resolve now drive the implemented M_Leaves, M_Foliage, M_Rock, and M_StylizedClouds_Lite paths. The resolve includes nine-tap polynomial/HDR current filtering, YCoCg sample-distance history clamp, five-fetch Catmull-Rom history, .04 source weight, velocity reprojection, and available raw-velocity dynamic classification. Quality High correctly uses PF_FloatRGBA; the configured R11G11B10 cvar is inactive for this permutation. Remaining: responsive-AA stencil classification, UE encoded primitive-mobility ownership, stochastic PF_FloatRGBA half quantization/exact half arithmetic, non-identity pre-exposure changes, evaluated per-instance fade/LOD values, pixel sign-off, and runtime bindings for full clouds, sandfall, waterfall, and MF_DesertSand.

Both SnowPines RVTs, volumes, landscape declarations, ten lossless 505x505 painted weight layers, and NoRVT instance overrides are exported. Remaining: reproduce landscape RVT base-color/normal/roughness/height writes, page/filter/border precision, mesh reader sampling, and camera-warmed residency/evaluated pixels.
Authored LOD meshes exist; match per-camera screen-size selection and record the evaluated LOD per frame.

All 369 static-mesh components export and consume their cast-shadow, dynamic-shadow, visibility, WPO, bounds, and LOD-related properties; the SnowPines runtime verifies all 19 authored non-shadow-casting components.
